text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali chairs parade on 41st anniversary of army.
- Jordanian Prime Minister Majali to start three-day official visit to Tunis on Wednesday at invitation of Tunisian Prime Minister Karoui.
- Parliament ratifies 200 million French franc loan accord signed on May 26 with Caisse Francaise de Developpement to finance local investment projects.
- Tunisian exports to Europe hampered by lack of road haulage, Mohamed Ben Sedrine, head of Tunisian Federation of Transport, says.

- "No success in the environment sector without solidarity between states" President Ben Ali says in speech delivered on his behalf by Environment Minister Mlika at 19th United Nations meeting on environment.
- Agriculture Minister Bahri says Tunisia aims at self-sufficiency in red meat and end to imports of cows by year 2001.
